lines.speaker: Sergeant Wickramasinghe
lines.text: Ballot fold. Simple. You fold it in half — once, vertically — to conceal your preference. That is the instruction given at every polling station.

lines.speaker: Sergeant Wickramasinghe
lines.text: Thirds. I have heard that one. Voice note, was it? Somebody's brother-in-law?

lines.speaker: Sergeant Wickramasinghe
lines.text: The presiding officer at your station will demonstrate the fold before you enter the booth. You can ask them to repeat it. That is literally what they are there for.
